description: REQ-005 limits scoring to the first three deliveries in deterministic local-day order but does not name the ordering timestamp or a tie-breaker. Equal occurred_at or resolved_at values permit different triggers and source references to win the cap, so deterministic audit linkage cannot be implemented from this contract.

evidence.snippet: Only the first three otherwise-valid deliveries in deterministic local-day order may add points; cap overflow does not.
